mentions.name: Email-based photo postcard service
mentions.description: This service lets users email photos in and receive them as physical mailed postcards, minimizing the friction of traditional photo printing for sharing pictures with family.
mentions.problem: Printing photos at services like Walgreens involves friction that stops people from doing it; email-based submission reduces almost all of that friction.
mentions.audience: Families — the author's young children and grandparents, who love receiving the postcards
mentions.source_excerpt: An email-based service to mail your photos as postcards. As a parent of littles: the littles love the postcards, and the grandparents love them too.

evidence.value: An email-based service to mail your photos as postcards. As a parent of littles: the littles love the postcards, and the grandparents love them too.
